name: momentum-stocks-displacement-v1
description: Slot-displacement/hysteresis axis for the TSM stocks sleeve — the twin of momentum-crypto-displacement-v1, pre-registered 2026-09-07 BEFORE any run, universe and window FROZEN to experiments/momentum-stocks-v1.json (10 symbols, 2024-01-01..2026-07-15 asOf-pinned, 3x3 purged folds, costs base 2/0 stress 5/2, SPY B&H benchmark, vol trail tsmTrail 3sigma incumbent). Weakness attacked: the stocks book shows the churn class at LARGER scale than crypto — GLD 5 entries in 14 days, NVDA re-entered the day after a -$621 trail stop (both documented at cooldown-v1 registration) — and this sleeve already FAILED its protocol runs on minExcessReturnVsBench (stop-sizing-v1: +16.48% vs SPY +31.15%), so every point of friction matters more here, not less. Hypothesis: slotHysteresis=true cuts displacement churn and recovers part of the benchmark shortfall. Declared case AGAINST: a 10-symbol stock universe rotates slower than crypto and displacement fires less often, so the effect may be too small to move the excess-return gate at all — a null result on this axis is expected and will be recorded as such; and in strong sector rotations hysteresis holds losers longer. Evidence gates (same rationale as the crypto twin, thresholds re-derived for this sleeve, all declared before any run): minOuterPsr 0.95, minFoldsPsrAbove {0.5, 2} of 3 outer folds, minBreakEvenSlippageBps 20 (10x the 2 bps base — megacap US equity fills are tight, so a strategy that cannot survive 20 bps has no live margin of safety), maxDisplacementShare 0.35, maxTurnoverAnnual 200 declared as HYPOTHESIS: gross cap is 2.0x equity (4 slots x 0.5), one full book rotation per week = 2 x 2.0 x 52 = 208x/yr, rounded to 200 — the fastest cadence compatible with the multi-week TSM thesis; deliberately NOT derived from the incumbent's own measured turnover (a self-anchored gate is vacuous) and the incumbent may fail it, which would itself be a pre-registered finding. trialAccounting arithmetic, documented in full: 259 = 251 (legacy v7 grid, inventoried in experiments/historical-hypothesis-ledger-v1.json) + 1 (momentum-stocks-v1 incumbent) + 4 (momentum-stop-sizing-v1's candidates) + 0 (momentum-stop-sizing-v2 re-ran those same configs on a longer window, adds 0 per the ledger identity rule) + 3 (momentum-timestop-v1's three time barriers; its incumbent-unlimited was a rerun). This manifest introduces 1 new hypothesis (no-displacement); incumbent is an execution-identity rerun. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates.
